codes: One code per view in enumeration order. Moves relative to the view: "+" towards larger indices (current .cw; target Ring.cw = (neighbors here).at 0, the k > 0 side of Line.window), "-" towards smaller indices, "0" stay. Two-color codes add the light request: "X", "Y" or "_" (none).

hPlusThree.enumeration: Occupancy views of radius r = 1..7, 2^(2r) views each: view k sets the 2r non-center cells, left to right, to the bits of k from the most significant one (1 = occupied); the center is occupied.

hPlusOne.enumeration: Occupancy views of radius r = 1..7, 2^(2r) views each: view k sets the 2r non-center cells, left to right, to the bits of k from the most significant one (1 = occupied); the center is occupied.

twoColors.enumeration: Color-set views of radius r = 1..3, 3·4^(2r) views each: for view k, the center is X, Y or Z for k mod 3 = 0, 1, 2, and floor(k / 3), written in base 4 with 2r digits (most significant first), gives the other cells left to right: 0 = empty, 1 = X only, 2 = Y only, 3 = both (Z). X is color 0, Y color 1.

samples.enumeration: 2000 distinct views per radius r = 4..8, as "view code" with the cells written ".XYZ".
